title: Pressure injury stages

findings.where: Live steps stage2 and stage3; pressure-injury.jsx wound Anim wrappers and kit.jsx @keyframes dg-fade
findings.title: The wound fade temporarily changes its anatomical depth
findings.problem: The shared fade animation also translates the wound downward by 6 units. The Stage 2 crater floor is at y=126 and fat begins at y=130, so its floor briefly crosses into fat during the entrance. In Stage 3, the slough moves with the wound while its leader remains fixed. This contradicts the intended fixed-depth entrance and is absent from paused Images 4–5 and 12–13.
findings.fix: Use an opacity-only entrance for wound geometry, without translation. Keep the wound contents and their callout anchors aligned throughout playback.

assessment: No blocking clinical error found in the pressure-injury definitions or prevention claims. One source-defined animation mismatch remains; the paused screenshots do not reveal it.
